fields.description: Mirasol’s original two-tower release contains 339 homes on Raha Island. Stepped terraces face Mina’s waterfront, while its mix includes apartments, separate chalet residences, duplexes and three-bedroom penthouses.

sources.label: RAK Properties · First Mirasol release sold out, 29 January 2025
RAK Properties · Original Mirasol unit drawings

overview: The original release is distinct from Mirasol II. A January 2025 sell-out announcement describes that launch; it is not a present resale inventory statement.
research.locationNote: Raha Island, within Mina, Ras Al Khaimah.
research.priceNote: The original factsheet’s AED 770,000 studio guide is historical. Property Finder’s latest launch reference is AED 1.7 million. Neither verifies a current selected-unit quotation.
research.paymentNote: The original factsheet gives 10% booking, 40% construction and 50% handover. It does not provide dates for individual construction instalments.
research.handoverNote: Primary material forecasts Q1 2028. An earlier Property Finder capture gave Q2; the latest capture instead lists January 2028. The 31 March 2026 investor snapshot reported 5.7% completion; this does not certify handover.
unresolved: Published component sums differ from some printed totals; totals below are retained.
